recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一團黏聚成合胞體樣的大型細胞，共享大片淡藍色細胞質、細胞界線不清，核大小不一、圓形至有切迹或腎形、染色質細緻並有小核仁，明顯比周圍造血細胞大；這種黏聚成團的非造血細胞即轉移性癌（此例為乳癌）。
features: Cohesive syncytial-appearing cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct cell borders
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with a few small clear vacuoles
Round to oval, indented or reniform nuclei with moderate anisonucleosis
Finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli; no mitoses evident
Background of poorly spread red cells; eyepiece photograph with pink cast and soft focus
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive, syncytial cluster of large cells that are clearly distinct from hematopoietic elements. The cells have abundant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles, indistinct borders, and round to indented nuclei with moderate size variation, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Gland formation or signet-ring cells are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow, in keeping with the reported breast primary; confirmation with trephine biopsy and immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, GATA3, ER) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are uniform with eccentric round nuclei and a Golgi zone away from the nucleus, without anisonucleosis or nuclear indentation.
An osteoclast is a single cell with many uniform, evenly spaced nuclei in granular cytoplasm and a defined outer border.
Megakaryocytes have one large lobulated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and platelet budding rather than multiple separate nuclei.

ddx.dx: Metastatic lobular carcinoma versus other adenocarcinoma primaries
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot establish the primary site; GATA3/ER/mammaglobin favor breast, TTF-1 lung and CDX2 gastrointestinal origin.
